preconditions.description: The number of nodes in each binary tree must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 10**9 for node in tree1_nodes) and all(1 <= node.val <= 10**9 for node in tree2_nodes)
preconditions.description: All node values in both binary trees must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
Both binary trees must have the same number of nodes.

postconditions.description: If all levels of the two binary trees are anagrams of each other, the output must be '1'.
If any level of the two binary trees is not an anagram of the corresponding level, the output must be '0'.
